{{Quote|It's how you learn. Getting hurt teaches you to shoot instinctively. That's why our instructors began training us with simunition that would hurt us without causing permanent damage. Then we moved on to live rounds.|Darman Skirata|<ref name="HC">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>}}
'''Simunition''' was a type of ammunition used to train [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. [[Darman Skirata|RC-1136]] of [[Omega Squad]] recalled that they hurt during training, but caused no permanent damage.<ref name="HC" />
